system.description:
Not every working needs to be rushed.

  • Given ten quiet minutes and no blade at your throat, you can draw out the same effect as a hasty combat cast — without burning the reserve you'd need in a fight.
  • Any spell of 3rd level or lower that you know, other than a healing spell, and that doesn't require an instantaneous action in combat, can be cast as a 10-minute ritual instead of spending a slot, provided you're not under threat of imminent combat.
  • Each spell can be ritual-cast once per day.
  • Sorcerers cannot take this feat.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.
